status: normative candidate; component qualification does not imply whole-process Cargo equivalence
c_abi: (source:*const u8,source_len:u64,output:*mut u8,output_capacity:u64,workspace:*mut u8,workspace_len:u64)->u64; HIA f0 returns zero-extended u32
platform: Borrowed-buffer ELF64 x86_64 primitive profile of pinned Hepta 0de5657a80f96b138525ac7ee9ce11712a83a10d

source.interpretation: STDIN_OK only inspects length. ENV_VALUE selects Preserve only for length 1 and byte 0x31; every other byte string selects Normalize. The raw ABI intentionally accepts opaque bytes, not UTF-8 strings, and performs no text parsing. A non-UTF8 raw value cannot equal the sole preserving value. Rust only passes env::var Ok String bytes to ENV_VALUE; every VarError uses ENV_UNAVAILABLE with an empty source.
source.capacity_limit: No copy, allocation, hard cap or index arithmetic; at most the sole byte is read after source_len==1.

workspace.access: read-only despite borrowed mutbuf transport type

output.value: RETURN_EXIT carries 0,1,2; RETURN_MODE carries 0 NormalizeToLf or 1 PreserveLineEndings. All other actions carry 0.

validation_order: If workspace_len<64 or output_capacity<64, return SHORT before reading any request or source byte.
If workspace_len!=64, return INVALID. Output may be larger than64.
Read the eight workspace words. Require revision1, entry0..1, phase0..16, event0..18 and all four reserved words0; otherwise INVALID.
If source_len!=0 outside RUN/STDIN/STDIN_OK or ENV/INITIAL/ENV_VALUE, return INVALID without reading source bytes.

Look up a listed legal transition and its specified source condition; no listed transition means INVALID. TERMINAL always rejects further events. For the env value equality check, read source[0] only if source_len==1.
After every validation and choice succeeds, publish all eight response words. There are no output/workspace stores on any nonzero return.

memory_contract.preconditions: Every nonempty advertised buffer is a live accessible allocation of at least its advertised length; source/output/workspace do not overlap. Pointer ownership stays with the caller.
memory_contract.nonzero_return: All source, output and workspace bytes are unchanged, including output tails and caller canaries.
memory_contract.zero_return: Source and workspace remain byte-identical; only output[0:64] changes.
memory_contract.state: No global state, retained pointers, allocations, host imports or side effects. Independent calls are reentrant. Replaying a valid request returns the same plan; this is not an anti-replay protocol. The Rust route executes each native-selected host action once.

host_boundary: Preserve original args_os and args.next calls, retaining argv0; native chooses argument conversion or stdin. OsString::into_string is the actual host conversion, not a Rust policy fallback.
Preserve actual stdin Read::read_to_string into String and its partial buffer/error. Native checks only the returned buffer length to choose empty-input usage.
Execute the six original eprintln expressions with their original argument values, macro formatting and panic behavior; do not buffer, merge, replace or catch their output.
Create stdout then stderr handles before AbsolutePathBuf::current_dir. Native chooses cwd diagnostic versus the original new_current_thread/enable_all/build call.
After runtime creation, perform PathUri::from_abs_path and the shared actual env reader. Its ENV entry alone owns the exact byte comparison and returns the typed update mode.

Execute runtime.block_on of the actual apply_patch_with_options with original default follow_symlinks, LOCAL_FS and sandbox None. Retain its Result until after the selected arm, including successful flush, to preserve payload destruction timing.
Success selects exactly one stdout.flush. Its Result is discarded without classification; COMPLETE selects exit0. Application failure selects exit1 without another diagnostic or explicit flush.
Return native-selected i32 from run_main, allowing its locals to drop. Only then does the unchanged main wrapper call process::exit.

source_identity.meaning: Exact original source records and routing preimage, not a hash of future modified toolchain sources.
